Read out of saint.gr's line for 11 Ιουλίου, «Άγιος Νεκτάριος από τα Βρύουλλα ο Νέος οσιομάρτυρας», with the rank words and the place left off. The page gives his baptismal name as Νικόλαος.

death.note: doxologia.ro: «Astfel Nectarie cămilarul din Vriulla, Efes, Asia Mică a suferit mucenicia din dragoste pentru Iisus Hristos la 11 iulie 1820.»

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 11 iulie — «Sfântul Mucenic Nectarie Aghioritul»

attestations.note: Nothing on the page connects him with Nektarios of Aegina, who died in 1920 and was a bishop; this Nectarius was a camel-driver of Vryoula who was beheaded in 1820.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιος Νεκτάριος από τα Βρύουλλα ο Νέος οσιομάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the place, the year and the manner agree with it exactly: Vryoula — Vourla — of Ephesus, beheaded 11 July 1820, which the Romanian source gave as «Nectarie cămilarul din Vriulla, Efes, Asia Mică… la 11 iulie 1820». He is none of the corpus's eight other men of the name. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The page prints a full service of kathismata and verses; the kathisma taken here is the one that names him and his story, and no apolytikion stands on the page under his line.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
